name: OpenBooks
description: OpenBooks is a web interface for searching and downloading eBooks from IRC Highway. It hides the IRC bots and commands behind a search page and saves the downloaded books to disk.

app_vars.name: var_openbooks_name
app_vars.label: IRC nickname
app_vars.help: Nickname used on IRC Highway. Leave empty for a random openbooks_xxxxxx name. Can be changed later in /opt/openbooks/.env

app_vars.name: var_openbooks_persist
app_vars.label: Keep downloaded books on disk
app_vars.help: yes: books are saved in /opt/openbooks/books. no: books are only sent to the browser and deleted afterwards. Change OPENBOOKS_ARGS in /opt/openbooks/.env later.

notes.text: The web UI has no login. Keep it on your LAN or put it behind a reverse proxy with authentication.
With persistent storage on, downloaded books are kept in /opt/openbooks/books.
